_status: PLACEHOLDER. Not buildable. libgphoto2 PR #144 is OPEN with unresolved review threads; the pin must be a merged SHA on feature/polaris-capture-events, never an unmerged branch head and never a git-am orphan. The values above are deliberately not valid SHAs so that no provenance row can be produced from this file silently.
purpose: Create the Astro 6.0.0.54.95 candidate carrying the corrected libgphoto2 (K-1 II shutter gate and uncached vendor-property verification) on top of the v94 standard camera baseline.

changes.summary: Move from driver main 43dccb81b to a merged commit on feature/polaris-capture-events. That branch, not main, carries pentax_model_answers_undeclared_generic_props (the #233 capability row) plus PR #144: non-bulb shutter writes now require CAN_CHANGE_TV and are refused before the wire, and verification reads the vendor property over uncached GetDevicePropValue instead of conditions offsets 272/276. Wording note: this pin is NOT a libgphoto2 main commit.

Verification mechanism change, must be re-tested on hardware. Drive mode moved from its conditions field onto the uncached GetDevicePropValue read; shutter moved from conditions offsets 272/276 onto it. White balance already used an uncached property read and keeps its existing wrapper and return codes - it did not change mechanism in this PR. Drive-mode WRITE verification is proven only by unit and source-contract tests; no body write was exercised, only the read path. EV stays on the conditions verifier.

Carry the v94 Astro integration unchanged apart from the driver pin and the evidence/docs corrections recorded on this branch: the liveview-crash-camera-offbus pack for #176, and the dated correction to the o-v17c 272/276 offset claim.

validation_focus: Re-verify EV write and read-back on a K-1 II against the pinned SHA. Issue #233's earlier PASS was recorded against driver 43df01ea9, not this build, and v94 exposed no EV widget at all.
Re-verify white balance write and read-back on a K-1 II against the pinned SHA, confirming the refactored shared verifier returns the same codes as before.
Exercise a drive-mode WRITE with read-back on a body. Only the read path was proven in PR #144.
Confirm the Bulb false pass is gone: SET 00:30 in B must return -1, not GP_OK.
Confirm non-bulb shutter writes in Bulb return -6 quickly rather than -1 after ten verification cycles.
Do not treat v94's missing EV/WB widget as a regression; driver main lacks the #233 capability row by design.
known_limits: Not buildable until PR #144 is merged and the six pin locations are updated together. See docs/V95-ASTRO-TEST-MATRIX.md section 4.

The Astro candidate build gate was changed on this branch: scripts/build-astro-candidate.sh previously required the libgphoto2 checkout to be on branch main, which rejected a valid feature-branch pin. It now requires LIB_BASELINE to be reachable from origin/main or origin/feature/polaris-capture-events, so orphan and unmerged commits are still refused. The pin value itself is unchanged at 43dccb81b until PR #144 merges.
scripts/build-release-candidate.sh:104 (the standard, non-Astro release line) still requires driver main. That is correct for the standard line and was deliberately left alone.
This candidate is not physical camera qualification. Rows 10-12 of docs/V95-ASTRO-TEST-MATRIX.md require instrumented transcripts, not operator observation.
The Astro boot hook is installed as /app/network_telnetd.sh and flashing replaces /app, deleting it. Until #265 lands, an Astro candidate can be installed-verified and still have no Astro behaviour.
